game_concept: A action puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor, a whispering corridor: the lantern keeper must handle giant bats while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Continue Gate: Use continue to skip spoiled crystal shards but keep the loop running.
theme: Shadow Cave – Whispering Corridor: a whispering corridor
core_gameplay_loop: In Whispering Corridor, repeat each round: Use continue to skip spoiled crystal shards but keep the loop running. Each round, a new crystal shards challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the skipped_ok value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 220 points of crystal shards by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 220, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 4 (applied tier): Continue Gate
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Continue Gate' (Week 4 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Whispering Corridor'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Shadow Cave
region.mood: echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how skipped_ok changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant bats in Whispering Corridor.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 220 within 39 seconds.
